**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

Section 11.2 gives us a genuine counterparty indemnity — Harpoon must defend, indemnify and hold harmless AbbVie, its Affiliates and their personnel against Losses from Third Party Claims — supported by full standard procedure in 11.3–11.4 (notice without forfeiture for delay, control of defence with reasonably acceptable counsel, our right to participate or take over on failure/conflict, consent to non-monetary settlements, cooperation and cost reimbursement). Third-party IP infringement exposure is captured because Section 7.4 handles third-party patent claims against AbbVie expressly "Subject to Section 11.2", and 11.4.1 is subject to 7.4/7.5/7.6. The indemnity also sits outside the consequential-damages exclusion and carries no super-cap, which is better than the playbook fallback.

Two items noted in the rationale rather than flagged: the substantive triggers in both 11.1 and 11.2 are redacted in this copy (confirm on execution that 11.2 reaches IP infringement, breach of law and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, and that our 11.1 indemnity stays confined to our own conduct), and the reciprocal structure is the ordinary licence bargain here rather than a one-way customer indemnity.
